headline.title: Muse Nail Studio, 0.3 km away, has 634 Google reviews. Maison de Beauté has 220.
headline.detail: Your rating is 5.0, as high or higher than theirs. The quality is there; the volume isn't yet. On a map, people comparing beauty salons often pick the bigger number.

summary: Maison de Beauté has 220 Google reviews at 5.0, and reviews praise care and precision that even help nail biters grow strong nails. We compared you with the 4 nearest independent beauty salons, and the gap is not quality but how easily new clients can find, trust and book you.
visibility: We compared Maison de Beauté with the 4 nearest independent beauty salons on Google Maps (ratings, review counts and opening hours as shown today).
lead: 220 Google reviews at 5.0: more than 1 of the 4 beauty salons nearby we compared.
Reviews praise care and precision that even help nail biters grow strong nails.
Open on Sundays, when some nearby beauty salons are closed.
lose: 3 of the 4 beauty salons nearby have more reviews, up to 634 (Muse Nail Studio).
Muse Nail Studio is open until 10pm on weekdays; you close at 9pm.
New clients who don't know you yet compare beauty salons on a phone in seconds; without your own booking-ready page, your best reviews stay buried in the listing.

gaps.title: The comparison happens before anyone calls
gaps.detail: People choosing a salon look at the map, the review count and a website, then book wherever it's easiest. Being the best isn't enough if it isn't visible.

gaps.title: Your strongest story is hidden
gaps.detail: Reviews praise care and precision that even help nail biters grow strong nails. But someone new only sees a star rating, not why people love you.

gaps.title: Every appointment without a follow-up is a missed review
gaps.detail: Happy clients rarely leave a review unless someone asks at the right moment. That's how bigger beauty salons pull ahead.

actions.title: Get a page that turns visitors into bookings
actions.why: Your reviews, treatments, hours and one-tap booking or WhatsApp on one fast page for phones.

actions.title: Ask every client for a review automatically
actions.why: A short message after each appointment; the quickest way to close the gap with beauty salons that have more reviews.

actions.title: Reply to every new review this week
actions.why: Doable today, without us: it shows new visitors a real person who cares, and they notice.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your treatments, team and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking or WhatsApp from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each appointment, so happy clients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Offers and win-back messages
plan.detail: Intro offers for new clients and gentle reminders for those who haven't booked in a while.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against the beauty salons nearby, and what to do next.

scenario: Someone new to Dubai Marina wants to book a appointment this week. On Sunday evening they open Maps, see a few beauty salons and tap the one with the most reviews and an easy booking page. Maison de Beauté, with 220 reviews at 5.0, is close by, but they never get past the listing. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your regular clients keep coming back. New clients keep choosing whichever salon looks easiest to book on their phone.
